name: bar-chart
description: Bars standing on the bottom of the content zone, straight on the chapter field — no card, no axes, no grid. Bars are paper; the one the line is about is haldi with its value circled by hand. Values in the headline face above each bar. Optional: prefix (e.g. "₹", default "") goes before every value, and a 0 bar then shows as a thin paper slab labelled "₹0" instead of a bare line.
